observations: --test-skip-pattern leaves a matching test out of node's report entirely (no '# SKIP' line), so 'reports no result other than skipped' holds as 'no result'. A reader counting skips in pass 1 will not find it.

packages/engine/test/standin.test.js leaves run/it* branches and worktrees at ../ccp-actors beside the checkout; a later npm test from a git worktree of the same repo then fails it. Full runs here used fresh clones. Worth its own fix item.
The build branch shows mergeable_state dirty against main; the builder rebases or merges main before merging. A merge of main that touches no verified file keeps these results.
